question: Can founders move without a fixed driver, does what a founder inherits change whether it survives a hostile encounter, and what happens to populations of founders through their first night, with how many reproductive opportunities?
scope: Reliability and the existence of genotype-dependent survival. It does not test whether a beneficial variant spreads (Experiment 006).

part_A_turn_fidelity.status: done before this protocol was frozen, and reported with it
part_A_turn_fidelity.diagnosis: A constant turn command was carried out for only 47.5 percent of the commanded rotation (ci/turn_diag, 300 decisions). The body read its yaw, added the turn and wrote it back, and a stale client packet overwrote the write about half the time.
part_A_turn_fidelity.fix: The body holds its intended heading for 8 steps, re-asserts it whenever the client disagrees, and derives direction of travel from it.
part_A_turn_fidelity.result: after the fix 299 of 299 decisions carried out exactly the commanded 8 steps (100 percent); ci/turn-diag.sh now fails below 98 percent
part_A_turn_fidelity.effect_on_earlier_experiments: none; earlier experiments ran from their own snapshots, and the fix changes live bodies only

bodies_and_genomes.expression: v2 (Experiment 004), baseline mode, no wander driver, no episodic or spatial memory
bodies_and_genomes.base_genome: all loci 32 except the additive drives (3 hunger_drive, 4 pain_flight, 9 locomotor_tone) which are 0
bodies_and_genomes.injection: SIM_LUANTI_FOUNDER_LOCI sets each founder's genome; replay uses the same genomes, so every live trace is verified exactly

development_history_not_results: Development used arena seeds 7001-7003 and 7101-7103 (consumed). It found that dead bodies stop making decisions so a fixture must end on death, that a replay must know the injected genome, and that single encounters are very noisy (one 'runner' took no damage in 120 s while a 'still' body died in 12 s), which is why every comparison below is paired and repeated. The genotypes and measures were fixed after that and not tuned on the seeds below.

part_B_movement_initiation.design: walled flat arena in daylight with no mobs, 600 decisions, one body, hunger held full
part_B_movement_initiation.arms: locomotor tone low (locus 9 = 8) against high (locus 9 = 56), everything else the base genome, matched by seed
part_B_movement_initiation.measure: path length in blocks over the run
pass: median path length of the high arm is at least 30 blocks
median path length of the high arm is at least 5 times that of the low arm
the high arm moves farther than the low arm in at least 7 of 8 pairs

part_C_hostile_encounter.design: walled flat arena at night with one zombie placed 10 blocks away at a seeded bearing, 1200 decisions (120 s) or until the body dies, one body, hunger held full
part_C_hostile_encounter.arms: the four genotypes still, tone, flight and runner, each on every seed
part_C_hostile_encounter.measures: decisions survived (1200 if the body lives), and damage taken (20 minus lowest health)
pass_genotype_dependent_survival: at least one of tone, flight, runner has a mean decisions-survived at least 25 percent above still's
and survives longer than still in at least 6 of the 8 seeds
part_C_hostile_encounter.report_only: which genotypes help, hurt, or do nothing; fraction of bodies alive at 120 s per genotype

part_D_first_night_populations.design: the real VoxeLibre survival world with natural mobs and the day-night cycle, four founders per population all of one genotype, capacity 6 (two free slots, so that survivors can actually reproduce), mutation off, v2 expression, run to natural extinction or 1500 s
part_D_first_night_populations.arms: genotype still and genotype runner, 2 replicate populations each (seeds 7401 and 7403)
part_D_first_night_populations.reproductive_opportunities: per individual, the number of distinct 10-second (100-decision) windows containing at least one reproduction attempt that met every biological condition (mature, enough reserve, signalling), whether or not a free slot existed. Counting attempts would be meaningless: an eligible individual in a full population asks on every decision.
measures: reproductive opportunity windows per individual (median and maximum)
individuals with at least 2 opportunity windows
stop reason, with natural extinction reported as an outcome and never recovered
part_D_first_night_populations.criterion_for_experiment_006: a genotype's populations are suitable for selection experiments if, in at least one replicate, at least 2 individuals reach at least 2 reproductive opportunities and at least one individual is alive at 1500 s. Extinction is allowed and reported; nothing is recovered or restarted.

infrastructure.frozen_build: the driver refuses a dirty tracked tree and runs every arm and the analysis from a snapshot binary, bridge mod, and script copied into the run directory
infrastructure.failure_rule: an arm that fails to write its result is rerun once before any result is inspected; a second failure stops the experiment as incomplete
infrastructure.after_outcomes: this file, the seeds, and the thresholds are not revised after any outcome is generated
